tasks.label: Build AAB (Prod)
tasks.command: VERSION=$(grep '^version:' pubspec.yaml | awk '{print $2}') && fvm flutter build appbundle --release --dart-define-from-file=.env.prod --build-name=$(echo $VERSION | cut -d+ -f1) --build-number=$(echo $VERSION | cut -d+ -f2)

tasks.label: Build IPA (Dev)
tasks.command: VERSION=$(grep '^version:' pubspec.yaml | awk '{print $2}') && fvm flutter build ipa --debug --dart-define-from-file=.env.dev --build-name=$(echo $VERSION | cut -d+ -f1) --build-number=$(echo $VERSION | cut -d+ -f2)

tasks.label: Build IPA (Dev) + Banner
tasks.command: VERSION=$(grep '^version:' pubspec.yaml | awk '{print $2}') && fvm flutter build ipa --debug --dart-define-from-file=.env.dev --dart-define=SHOW_BANNER=true --build-name=$(echo $VERSION | cut -d+ -f1) --build-number=$(echo $VERSION | cut -d+ -f2)

tasks.label: Build IPA (Local) + Banner
tasks.command: VERSION=$(grep '^version:' pubspec.yaml | awk '{print $2}') && fvm flutter build ipa --debug --dart-define-from-file=.env.local --dart-define=SHOW_BANNER=true --build-name=$(echo $VERSION | cut -d+ -f1) --build-number=$(echo $VERSION | cut -d+ -f2)

tasks.label: Build IPA (Staging)
tasks.command: VERSION=$(grep '^version:' pubspec.yaml | awk '{print $2}') && fvm flutter build ipa --profile --dart-define-from-file=.env.staging --build-name=$(echo $VERSION | cut -d+ -f1) --build-number=$(echo $VERSION | cut -d+ -f2)

tasks.label: Build IPA (Staging) + Banner
tasks.command: VERSION=$(grep '^version:' pubspec.yaml | awk '{print $2}') && fvm flutter build ipa --profile --dart-define-from-file=.env.staging --dart-define=SHOW_BANNER=true --build-name=$(echo $VERSION | cut -d+ -f1) --build-number=$(echo $VERSION | cut -d+ -f2)

tasks.label: Build IPA (Prod)
tasks.command: VERSION=$(grep '^version:' pubspec.yaml | awk '{print $2}') && fvm flutter build ipa --release --dart-define-from-file=.env.prod --build-name=$(echo $VERSION | cut -d+ -f1) --build-number=$(echo $VERSION | cut -d+ -f2)

tasks.label: Clean and Pub Get
tasks.command: fvm flutter clean && fvm flutter pub get
